proposals.evidence: Turner lists Kalasha poñ, West Pahari pañj/panc/pãs, Oriya pāñca and Gujarati pā̃c under pañca, with Kotgarhi/Koci pānj in the addendum. These complete cardinal responses retain the expected nasal-affricate/sibilant five series, including the survey’s final vowels and nasal notation. Classifier-bearing or visibly truncated responses are excluded.
